_doc: Canonical fixture for Step 4 storyboard_grid · 《早高峰冲》 morning-rush archetype. Single source-of-truth that v0.8 §4 envelope schema + storyboard-canvas widget are wired correctly. Future agents may diff against this fixture before emit (lint via fixture.test.ts).
_provenance: derived from user-supplied morning-rush storyboard reference (timecode-anchored 8 panels · 每panel独立shot + camera + lighting + capture_notes · block-level audio_atmosphere + key_props).

blocks.character_setup: [Character Lock: 28-34 male, East Asian, slim build, short black hair, navy suit + white shirt + loosened tie; face anchor: small scar on right eyebrow]
blocks.vein: Single 30-second arc tracing one worker's alarm → breakfast → commute → arrival. Documentary pacing, no dialogue; ambient city + breath soundscape carries the stress-to-relief arc. The product (single-origin cold-brew can) appears once in panel 03 as the calm anchor and reappears in panel 08 as arrival reward — visual rhyme closes the loop.
blocks.audio_atmosphere: 07:50 alarm beep → 07:55 espresso machine hiss → 08:00 door slam → 08:05 subway rumble + heartbeat → 08:10 office reception quiet. Continuous city-noise bed underneath; no music.
